title: PHASE II RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF PAPAVERINE IN PREVENTING ARTERIAL VASOSPASM AND REDUCING POSTOPERATIVE HYPOPARATHYROIDISM IN ADULT PATIENTS UNDERGOING TOTAL THYROIDECTOMY – PPPTH trial
official: PHASE II RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL TO EVALUATE THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF PAPAVERINE IN PREVENTING ARTERIAL VASOSPASM AND REDUCING POSTOPERATIVE HYPOPARATHYROIDISM IN ADULT PATIENTS UNDERGOING TOTAL THYROIDECTOMY – PPPTH trial
summary: Main objective: To verify whether intraoperative topical use of papaverine is effective in reducing the incidence of transient hypoparathyroidism on the first postoperative day following total thyroidectomy
conditions: Patients affected by benign or malignant thyroid disease
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients > or equal 18 years or <80 years
2. Patients undergoing total thyroidectomy
Exclusion criteria:
1. Inability to provide informed consent
2. Pregnant subjects
3. History of drug addiction and alcoholism
4. Serious neurological, respiratory or cardiovascular diseases that contraindicate the surgery itself or any prolongation of the operating times
5. Previous neck surgery
6. Presence of severe arthritis or osteoporosis of the spine
7. American Society of Anesthesiologists score >2
8. Type III atrioventricular block
sponsor: Azienda Provinciale Per I Servizi Sanitari
